description: This file implements a SetManipulator class providing set operations such as union, intersection, difference, complement, and equality check, with internal histogram processing for set comparisons.

classes.name: SetManipulator
classes.description: A class providing efficient set operations (union, intersection, difference, complement, equals) using histograms for frequency analysis.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes two arrays to generate a histogram or filtered array based on an evaluator function, used internally for set operations.

methods.name: union
methods.description: Returns the union of two sets as an array.

methods.name: intersection
methods.description: Returns the intersection of two sets as an array.

methods.name: difference
methods.description: Returns the symmetric difference of two sets as an array.

methods.name: complement
methods.description: Returns items from the first set that are not in the second set.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if two sets are equivalent.
